A. LCD NO DISPLAY
1. Fuse melts (in the Power Source Box and main PCB)
2. Power supply circuit Poorly connected
3. EMC Board Failed
4. Main PCB failed
B. LCD HAS DISPLAY
1. Mechanical switch fails or it's wire is broken
2. Up or Down Stroke Photoelectricity was failed
3. Main PCB failed
4. kneading all the time from power and no response with other button
entries.troubleshooting:
For A (LCD NO DISPLAY):
1. Replace Fuse
2. Replace Power Box
3. Replace EMC Board
4. Replace main PCB
For B (LCD HAS DISPLAY):
1. replace mechanical switch or wire
2. Replace stroke photoelecruicity
3. Replace main PCB
4. Replace Width Inspection Board

2. change the up & down limit sensor

entries.meaning: Fault Description: Backrest heating does not work\nPossible Causes:\n1. Backrest heating drive circuit issue. 2. Overload or short circuit of the backrest heating. 3. Fault in the mainboard heating circuit. 4. The heater is open-circuited, the plug-in is loose or the wire is broken.
entries.troubleshooting: Check the drive board, backrest pad, heating wire connector, and harness for looseness and replace related components.

entries.meaning: Fault Description: Foot roller motor does not work\nPossible Causes:\n1. Foot roller motor drive circuit issue. 2. The foot roller motor malfunctioned, causing excessive current. 3. Excessive current is caused by motor blockage due to excessive load or other reasons.
entries.troubleshooting: Check the calf junction board motor connector, drive board connector, harness, and motor for looseness and replace related components.

entries.meaning: Fault Description: Air pump does not work\nPossible Causes:\n1. Air pump drive circuit issue. 2. The air pump malfunctions, causing excessive current. 3. Excessive current occurs when the air pump is blocked due to overloading or other reasons.
entries.troubleshooting: Check the drive board and air pump for looseness and replace related components.

entries.meaning: Fault Description: Calf heating does not work\nPossible Causes:\n1. Calf heating drive circuit issue. 2. Overload or short circuit of the calf heating. 3. Fault in the mainboard heating circuit. 4. The heater is open-circuited, the plug-in is loose or the wire is broken.
entries.troubleshooting: Check the calf junction board connector, drive board connector, harness, and heating wire for looseness and replace related components.

entries.meaning: Fault: Communication error between mechanical hand and main board\nPossible Causes:\n1. J31 mechanical hand failure.
entries.troubleshooting: Check the mechanical hand drive board, drive board, wiring, and connectors for looseness and replace related components if necessary.

entries.meaning: Fault Description: Footrest does not lift\nPossible Causes:\n1. Travel detection Hall element damaged. 2. Motor failure. 3. Motor drive circuit issues. 4. The motor fails to work properly due to excessive load or other reasons. 5. The upper and lower limit switch wires are not properly connected. 6. The upper and lower limit switches are damaged (one or two).
entries.troubleshooting: Replace the electric cylinder of the lower leg, the drive board, and inspect the connection plug-in and wiring harness of the electric cylinder.

entries.meaning: Fault Description: Backrest does not lift\nPossible Causes:\n1. Circle detection Hall element damaged. 2. Motor failure. 3. Motor drive circuit issues. 4. The motor fails to work properly due to excessive load or other reasons.
entries.troubleshooting: Replace the backrest electric cylinder and drive board, and check whether the wiring harness and plug-in of the backrest electric cylinder are properly connected.

entries.meaning: Fault Description: stretch motor has problem\nPossible Causes:\n1. Problems with the drive circuit of the telescopic motor. 2. The telescopic motor malfunctioned, causing excessive current. 3. The detection plate for the number of turns that can be extended or retracted is damaged. 4. Check if the magnet for the telescopic detection has fallen off.
entries.troubleshooting: Check whether the stretch detection board, stretch motor, stretch upper and lower magnets, the drive circuit of the mechanical hand drive board and related plug-ins are loose and in good condition, and replace the relevant parts.

entries.meaning: Fault: Kneading width detection signal not detected\nPossible Causes:\n1. Kneading width detection photoelectric pair 1/2 is damaged.
entries.troubleshooting: Check the width detection board, kneading motor, mechanical hand drive board drive circuit, and associated connectors for looseness and replace related components if necessary.

entries.meaning: Fault: Overload or short circuit in travel motor drive circuit\nPossible Causes:\n1. Travel motor drive circuit issues.
entries.troubleshooting: Check the circle detection board, travel motor, mechanical hand drive board drive circuit, and associated connectors for looseness and replace related components if necessary.

entries.meaning: Fault Description: Tapping motor has problem\nPossible Causes:\n1. There is a problem with the motor drive circuit. 2. The tapping motor malfunctioned, causing excessive current. 3. Excessive current is caused by motor blockage due to overloading or other reasons.
entries.troubleshooting: Check whether the width detection board, the tapping motor, the drive circuit of the massage hand drive board and the related plug-ins are loose and in good condition, and replace the relevant accessories.

entries.meaning: Fault: Mechanical hand limit switch detected simultaneously\nPossible Causes:\n1. Upper and lower limit switch wires are not properly connected.
entries.troubleshooting: Check the magnet holder, magnet, and travel detection board connectors for looseness and replace related components if necessary.

entries.meaning: Fault: Upper travel position not detected / Lower travel position not detected\nPossible Causes:\n1. Upper and lower position signal wires are not properly connected.
entries.troubleshooting: Check the circle detection board, travel motor, mechanical hand drive board drive circuit, and associated connectors for looseness and replace related components if necessary.

entries.meaning: Fault: Shoulder position detection signal not detected\nPossible Causes:\n1. Shoulder position detection slot-type optocoupler is damaged.
entries.troubleshooting: Check the shoulder detection board, connectors, and mechanical hand drive board for looseness and replace related components if necessary.

Lower calf telescopic upper and lower limit sensor is broken

Detection sensor wire

replace the sensor

Zero-gravity push rod motor is broken

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Remote Control Button
Meaning: The remote control detects that the button has been pressed for more than 40 seconds.
Possible Causes: There is a key card slot.
Remarks: Real-time detection.
entries.troubleshooting: Check the buttons of the manual controller.

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Hand Controller Communication
Meaning: The hand controller failed to successfully communicate with the central panel for more than 4 seconds.
Possible Causes: The connection of the remote control is disconnected.
Remarks: Real-time detection.
entries.troubleshooting: Replace the connection of the manual controller.

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Upper and Lower Limit Sensors
Meaning: Both the upper and lower limit position sensors are functioning properly.
Possible Causes:
1.  The upper and lower limit position sensors are faulty.
2.  The connection wires of the back frame have come off.
Remarks: Real-time detection.
entries.troubleshooting:
1.  Replace the upper and lower limit position sensors.
2.  Check the connection of the bracket signal lines.

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Mechanism Movement Walking Count
Meaning: When the movement of the mechanism is activated, an abnormality in the walking count is detected.
Possible Causes:
1.  The back frame signal has poor contact with the plug-in line.
2.  The travel counter sensor is faulty.
Remarks: When the movement has the walking function and is activated, it will conduct real-time detection.
entries.troubleshooting:
1.  Check if the back frame signal plug is properly inserted.
2.  The travel counter sensor is faulty.

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Side Panel Button
Meaning: The side panel detected that the button was pressed for more than 45 seconds.
Possible Causes: There is a key card slot.
Remarks: Real-time detection.
entries.troubleshooting: Check the side panel buttons.

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Kneading Motor Rotation Count
Meaning: The 5S clock failed to detect the rotation count signal of the kneading motor.
Possible Causes:
1.  Width detection board is damaged.
2.  Width board connection is abnormal.
3.  Squeezing motor is broken or the belt has come off.
Remarks: When entering the self-check mode, the detection is carried out.
entries.troubleshooting:
1.  Replace the width detection plate.
2.  Replace the signal lines of the rear frame.
3.  Replace the motor.

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Wide-Width Signal
Meaning: The 5S clock did not detect the wide-width signal.
Possible Causes:
1.  Width detection board is damaged.
2.  Width board connection is abnormal.
3.  Squeezing motor is broken or the belt has come off.
Remarks: When entering the self-check mode, the detection is carried out.
entries.troubleshooting:
1.  Replace the width detection plate.
2.  Replace the signal lines of the rear frame.
3.  Replace the motor.

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Limit Position Sensors (Dual Functioning)
Meaning: Both the upper and lower limit position sensors are functioning properly.
Possible Causes:
1.  The upper and lower limit position sensors are faulty.
2.  The connection wires of the back frame have come off.
Remarks: When entering the self-check mode, the detection is carried out.
entries.troubleshooting:
1.  Replace the upper and lower limit position sensors.
2.  Check the connection of the bracket signal lines.

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Upper Limit Sensor Signal
Meaning: The upper limit sensor signal was not detected within 40 seconds.
Possible Causes:
1.  The upper limit position sensor is faulty.
2.  The connection line of the back frame has come off.
3.  The walking motor is faulty or there is a broken wire.
Remarks: When entering the self-check mode, the detection is carried out.
entries.troubleshooting:
1.  Replace the limit sensor board.
2.  Check the connection of the frame signal lines.
3.  Replace the walking motor or rewire.

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Mechanism Movement Walking Count (Self-Check)
Meaning: When the movement of the mechanism is activated, an abnormality in the walking count is detected.
Possible Causes:
1.  The back frame signal has poor contact with the plug-in line.
2.  The travel counter sensor is faulty.
Remarks: When entering the self-check mode, the detection is carried out.
entries.troubleshooting:
1.  Check if the back frame signal plug is properly inserted.
2.  The travel counter sensor is faulty.

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Upper & Lower Limit Sensor Logic
Meaning: The upper limit position sensor detected the signal, and within 2 seconds after that, it also detected the signal from the lower limit position sensor.
Possible Causes: The lower (upper) limit position sensor is faulty.
Remarks: When entering the self-check mode, the detection is carried out.
entries.troubleshooting:
1.  Replace the lower (upper) limit sensor plate.
2.  Check the connection of the lower (upper) limit sensor wire.

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Lower Limit Sensor Signal
Meaning: The lower limit sensor signal was not detected within 40 seconds.
Possible Causes:
1.  The lower limit position sensor is faulty.
2.  The connection line of the back frame has come off.
3.  The walking motor is faulty or there is a break in the connection line.
Remarks: When entering the self-check mode, the detection is carried out.
entries.troubleshooting:
1.  Replace the limit sensor board.
2.  Check the connection of the frame wire.
3.  Replace the faulty walking motor or the connecting wires.

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Lower & Upper Limit Sensor Logic
Meaning: The lower limit position sensor detected the signal, and within 2 seconds, it also detected the signal from the upper limit position sensor.
Possible Causes: Upper (lower) limit position sensor is faulty.
Remarks: When entering the self-check mode, the detection is carried out.
entries.troubleshooting:
1.  Replace the upper (lower) limit sensor plate.
2.  Check the connection of the upper (lower) limit sensor wires.

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Lower Leg Push Rod
Meaning: The push rod of the lower leg was activated for 2.5 seconds but no counting signal was detected (Or no push rod position signal was detected after 40 seconds).
Possible Causes:
1.  The motor of the lower leg pusher is broken.
2.  The connection wire of the lower leg pusher motor has come off.
Remarks: When entering the self-check mode, the detection is carried out.
entries.troubleshooting:
1.  Replace the motor of the lower leg push rod.
2.  Check the connection of the lower leg push rod motor.

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Board Communication
Meaning: The communication between the movement plate and the center plate failed after more than 6 seconds.
Possible Causes: The connection lines of the movement board are disconnected.
Remarks: Real-time detection.
entries.troubleshooting: Replace the connection lines of the movement plate.

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Back Push Rod
Meaning: The back push rod was activated for 2.5 seconds but no counting signal was detected (Or no push rod position signal was detected after 40 seconds).
Possible Causes:
1.  The motor of the back push rod is broken.
2.  The connection wire of the back push rod motor has come off.
3.  The connection wire for the count of the back push rod has come off.
Remarks: Self-checking is activated and begins the detection process.
entries.troubleshooting:
1.  Replace the back push rod motor.
2.  Check the connection of the back push rod motor.
3.  Check the connection of the back push rod counter.

entries.meaning: The hand controller button was pressed for more than 45s without letting go
entries.troubleshooting:
1. Check the status of each button carefully
2. Replace the hand controller

entries.meaning: The hand controller does not communicate with the center board for more than 4s
entries.troubleshooting:
1. Check or replace the plug-in cable
2. Replace the hand controller
3. Replace the center board

entries.meaning: Position coding anomaly of the rolling mechanism walking moto, That is ,the code disk is in the incorrect position.
entries.troubleshooting:
1. Replacement of sensors
2. Move the rolling mechanism to the initial height position
3. Replacement of rolling mechanism board

entries.meaning: Abnormal speed senso of the rolling mechanism walking moto, That is ,no change of speed code disk was detected in excess of 6S.
entries.troubleshooting:
1. Check the connection between the motor and the rolling mechanism board
2. Check or replace moto
3. Replacement of rolling mechanism board

entries.meaning: the position sensor is abnormal of Core kneading moto, That is, no change of position code disk is detected over 10S.
entries.troubleshooting:
1. Check the connection between the sensor and the rolling mechanism board
2. Replacement of sensors
3. Check or replace moto
4. Replacement of movemetn board

entries.meaning: Abnormal speed senso of Core kneading moto, That is, more than 6S did not detect the speed code disk change.
entries.troubleshooting:
1. Check the connection between the motor and the rolling mechanism board
2. Check or replace moto
3. Replacement of rolling mechanism board

entries.meaning: One of kneading motor / walking motor / Backrest push rod / Leg Rest push rod overcurrent
entries.troubleshooting:

2. Check or replace rolling mechanism
3. Check or replace push rod

entries.meaning: The count sensor is abnormal of the Backrest push rod.
entries.troubleshooting:

2. Check or replace the push rod
3. Replace the center board

entries.meaning: The count sensor is abnormal of the Leg Rest push rod
entries.troubleshooting:

2. Check or replace the push rod
3. Replace the center board

entries.meaning:

Meaning: Controller detects that some buttons have been pressed for over 40secs

Remarks: Live-time-on-the-spot detection
entries.troubleshooting: Check buttons of the controller

entries.meaning:

entries.troubleshooting:

2. replace the controller wires

entries.meaning:

2. Up/Down limit sensor is broken.
3. Rolling motor or the wire is broken
Remarks: Live-time detection when active.
entries.troubleshooting:

entries.meaning:

2. Width inspection board fail to connect well.
Remarks: activate auto-check model
entries.troubleshooting:

2. Replace backrest signal wires

entries.troubleshooting:

3. Replace the kneading motor.

entries.meaning:

entries.troubleshooting:

entries.meaning:

entries.meaning:

Meaning: more than 10 seconds didn't tested kneading signal

entries.troubleshooting: change PCB

entries.meaning:

2. Backrest wire broken
3. Rolling Motor broken or the wire

entries.troubleshooting:

Meaning: height counting signal error
Possible Causes:
1. Backrest wire(black) is disconnected
2. The counting sensor of the rolling motor is broken
Remarks: activate auto-check model
entries.troubleshooting:

2. Change the counting sensor of the rolling motor.

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Limit Sensor Sequential Logic (Upper to Down)
Meaning: Sensor detects upper limit signal 2S and then the down limit sensor is detected.
Possible Causes: Either the upper or the down sensor is broken.
Remarks: activate auto-check model
entries.troubleshooting:
1. Replace the sensor.
2. Check the connection between then.

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Lower Limit Signal Timing

1. The sensor is broken
2. The backrest wire is off.
3. Rolling broken or the wire off.
Remarks: activate auto-check model
entries.troubleshooting:
1. Replace the down limit sensor board.
2. Check the backrest wire.
3. Replace the rolling mtor or the wire.

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Limit Sensor Sequential Logic (Lower to Upper)
Meaning: Sensor detects lower limit signal 2S and then the upper limit sensor is detected.
Possible Causes: Either the up or the down sensor is broken.
Remarks: activate auto-check model
entries.troubleshooting:
1. Replace the up or down limit sensor.
2. Check the connection between then.

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Footrest Actuator Timing
Meaning: No counting signals have been detected after footrest actuator has on for 2.5S (Or no signals have been detected after 40S)
Possible Causes:
1. Footrest actuator is broken
2. Footrest actuator motor wire is pulled off
Remarks: activate auto-check model
entries.troubleshooting:
1. Replace footrest actuator motor
2. Check footrest actuator motor wire

entries.meaning:

Meaning: No counting signals have been detected after backrest actuator has on for 2.5S (Or no signals have been detected after 40S)
Possible Causes:
1. Backrest actuator is broken
2. Backrest actuator motor wire is pulled off
Remarks: activate auto-check model
entries.troubleshooting:
1. Replace backrest acutator motor.
2. Check backrest actuator motor connections.

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: Zero-Gravity Actuator Timing
Meaning: When start the zero-gravity actuator, there is no counting signal for more than 2.5 seconds
Possible Causes:
1. Zero-gravity actuator is broken
2. zero-gravity actuator wire is disconnected.
3. the signal wire of zero-gravity actuator is disconnected
Remarks: activate auto-check model
entries.troubleshooting:
1. change zero-gravity actuator
2. check whether the zero-gravity motor wire is well connected.
3. check whether the signal wire of zero-gravity actuator is well connected

entries.meaning:
Subject Area: 3D Mechanism Extension Sensor
Meaning: 3D massage mechanism counting sensor of extension motor signal error
Possible Causes:
1. 3D extension counting sensor is broken
2. 3D extension counting sensor is disconnected
Remarks: Live-time-on-the-spot detection
entries.troubleshooting:
1. Replace the 3D extension counting sensor
2. Check whether 3D extension counting sensor is well connected

entries.meaning:

Possible Causes: 3D limit sensor is broken
Remarks: Live-time-on-the-spot detection
entries.troubleshooting: Replace the 3D limit sensor
